title: Lanthanide Coordination with α-Amino Acids under Near Physiological pH Conditions: Polymetallic Complexes Containing the Cubane-Like [Ln4(μ3-OH)4]8+ Cluster Core

synthesis.procedure: Glycine (0.600 g, 8.00 mmol) was added as a solid to aqueous Sm(ClO4)3 (1.0 M, 16 mL). With stirring at 80 °C, aqueous NaOH (0.5 M, ca. 5 mL) was added dropwise to the initially acidic solution (pH 2) to the point of incipient precipitation. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate stood at room temperature; parallelepiped crystals appeared in about one week. The product was collected by filtration, washed with THF/ether (1:1 v/v), and dried over silica gel. Yield 45%.
